description: Significant minority equity stake and exclusive cloud supercomputing provider partnership.
Primary hardware supplier of high-end AI acceleration GPUs (H100, B200) and equity backer.
Strategic $4B minority investor and primary cloud infrastructure provider (AWS).
20-year power purchase agreement for 835 MW clean energy output from Crane Clean Energy Center.
Lead private credit provider across $2.3B (2023) and $7.5B (2024) GPU-backed facilities.
Susquehanna nuclear power station direct campus interconnect providing up to 960 MW.
Master agreement to deploy 500 MW of advanced fluoride salt SMR nuclear generation.
$3.4 billion joint venture to fund Lancium 200MW AI data center campus in Texas.
20-year power purchase agreements for 2,609 MW of nuclear capacity and uprates across Perry, Davis-Besse, and Beaver Valley.
Lead financial sponsor of $500B Project Stargate and major equity investor in OpenAI.
Global AI Infrastructure Investment Partnership (GAIIP) general partner targeting $30B equity and $100B leverage.
Strategic investor participating in $700M private placement alongside Accel.
150 MW geothermal clean baseload off-take agreement for Meta AI data center operations.
Co-lead arranger for $8.5B investment-grade delayed draw term loan facility (DDTL 4.0).
Joint venture sponsor expanding Abilene Lancium clean compute campus to $15B and 1.2 GW.
Gigawatt-scale OCI computing agreement deploying hundreds of thousands of NVIDIA Blackwell GPUs.
Restructured 17-year 1,920 MW front-of-the-meter nuclear PPA (~$18B) from Susquehanna plant.
Strategic investor participating in $650M private placement at $23B valuation prior to Nasdaq listing.
25-year corporate PPA purchasing 615 MW nuclear generation from restarted Duane Arnold Energy Center.
Up to 500 MW clean fast-fission power off-take agreement and prepayment.
100% consortium acquisition of APAC hyperscale data center leader AirTrunk for A$24B+ (~US$16B).
Nuclear small modular reactor (SMR) development agreement to power AWS Virginia cloud facilities.
Multi-gigawatt clean energy and storage generation framework for Google AI compute.
100% sponsor ownership backing $25B+ hyperscale AI data center development program.
$7.0B joint venture developing four hyperscale campuses across Europe and the US.
$2.0B strategic equity investment in Nebius to deploy 5 GW of NVIDIA Rubin/Vera architecture.
Cornerstone shareholder and provider of €575M debt facility and 10,000+ H100 GPU contribution.
Lead institutional investor in Groq $640M Series D funding round at $2.8B valuation.
$2.0B zero-coupon convertible bond financing to build MEA headquarters and AI server manufacturing in Riyadh.
Strategic investor participating across Together AI Series A and Series B rounds.
Strategic investor in Mistral AI €600M Series B financing round.
SoftBank holds ~90% controlling equity ownership in Arm Holdings plc, serving as the architectural core for Project Izanagi custom AI silicon initiatives.
Extensive bilateral negotiations to establish a landmark $40 billion AI and frontier tech fund (Project Transcendence) based in Riyadh and Silicon Valley.
Hardware design partnership between Jony Ive (LoveFrom) and Sam Altman (OpenAI) creating dedicated consumer AI devices under "io".
Offshore cloud infrastructure procurement leasing NVIDIA H100 GPU clusters via Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI) in US and international regions.
Federal regulatory jurisdiction; FERC rejected the PJM Interconnection ISA amendment (Docket ER24-2172) for 480 MW Susquehanna nuclear colocation with AWS.
OpenAI multi-year $11.9B compute purchaser from CoreWeave with follow-on awards to ~$22.4B in 2025.
Microsoft $17.4B AI infrastructure purchaser from Nebius through 2031, expandable to $19.4B.
Meta $12B dedicated capacity purchaser from Nebius over five years with up to $15B optional capacity.
Meta 49% non-voting stakeholder in Scale AI (~$14.3B) with founder Alexandr Wang joining Meta.
AMD acquisition of ZT Systems for $4.9B to integrate rack-scale AI server systems.
Macquarie Asset Management up to $5B commitment backing Applied Digital HPC campus development.
Meta-Blue Owl Capital ~$27B joint venture financing the Hyperion AI data center campus.
Seven-year $38B AWS compute commitment for OpenAI training and inference workloads.
Non-binding LOI for 10 GW NVIDIA-system deployment with up-to-$100B progressive investment; reported stalled with no definitive agreement as of early 2026.
Multi-generation Instinct GPU supply up to 6 GW with warrant for up to 160M AMD shares.
Morgan Stanley acted as arranger and lender syndicate lead for xAI $5 billion secured notes and term loan financing.
Founders Fund led Crusoe $600M Series D at a $2.8B valuation.
Aker ASA led Nscale $1.1B Series B with a $285M commitment for a 9.3% fully diluted stake.
NVIDIA participated in Lambda $480M Series D co-led by Andra Capital and SGW.
Goldman Sachs Bank Europe SE acted as sole placement agent on Nebius $1B convertible notes private placement.
J.P. Morgan Securities LLC acted as joint book-running manager on Oracle $18 billion investment-grade senior notes offering.
Morgan Stanley acted as joint book-running manager on Meta $30 billion senior notes offering.
Morgan Stanley acted as lead manager of the US dollar tranche of Alphabet $25 billion global bond sale.
JPMorgan Chase acted as managing bank on Amazon $15 billion US bond offering.
xAI owns X Corp following the March 2025 all-stock acquisition valuing X at $33B in equity.
MGX co-lead equity investor in Databricks Series K at a valuation over $100 billion.
Berkshire Hathaway agreed a $10B direct stock purchase as cornerstone of Alphabet June 2026 equity capital raise.
Google holds a Marvell warrant for up to 58,970,907 shares (~7%, ~$12.2B) vesting on chip purchases through FY2033.
Morgan Stanley & Co. LLC acted as named capped-call option counterparty on CoreWeave $2.5875B convertible notes.
J.P. Morgan acted as lead joint bookrunning manager on Supermicro $5B underwritten equity package.
Andreessen Horowitz equity investor in Safe Superintelligence from the $1B September 2024 round.
NVIDIA participating equity investor in Mistral AI Series C alongside ASML, a16z and others.
20-year power purchase agreement for 1,121 MW Clinton Clean Energy Center output replacing Illinois ZEC support.
Amazon-funded Xe-100 SMR development with right to purchase 320 MW first-phase output (expandable to 960 MW).

NVIDIA purchased $5.0B of newly issued Intel common stock (~214.8M shares at $23.28) in a private placement completed December 26, 2025, roughly a 4% stake, tied to the NVIDIA-Intel x86/NVLink product collaboration.
SoftBank purchased $2.0B of newly issued Intel common stock (86,956,522 shares at $23.00) in a private placement completed September 26, 2025.
NVIDIA committed to invest up to $10B in Anthropic alongside a deep technology partnership optimizing Claude for NVIDIA Grace Blackwell/Vera Rubin architectures.
Microsoft committed to invest up to $5B in Anthropic as part of the expanded partnership scaling Claude on Azure and across Microsoft Foundry/Copilot.
OpenAI contracted an incremental $250B purchase of Azure services under the next-phase partnership; Microsoft dropped its right of first refusal as OpenAI’s compute provider.
Anthropic committed to purchase $30B of Azure compute capacity with up to 1 GW additional capacity, scaling Claude on Azure powered by NVIDIA systems.
Reported six-year >$10B Google Cloud commitment by Meta for AI infrastructure (GPUs/TPUs, servers, storage, networking).
Meta order form under the December 2023 MSA committing up to ~$14.2B of dedicated AI cloud capacity through December 14, 2031, with option to materially expand through 2032.

Google holds TeraWulf warrants for 73,580,000 shares at $0.01 exercise (~14% pro forma equity) received in consideration for backstopping Fluidstack’s Lake Mariner lease obligations (CB-3/CB-4 then CB-5).
Google holds Cipher warrants for 24,178,576 shares at $0.01 exercise (~5.4% pro forma equity, expiring September 24, 2030) received for backstopping Fluidstack’s Barber Lake lease obligations.
Andreessen Horowitz participated in Anysphere’s $900M Series C at a $9.9B valuation (June 2025), alongside lead Thrive Capital, Accel and DST Global.
NVIDIA reported investing as much as $2B in the equity portion of the ~$20B SPV financing that purchases NVIDIA processors and leases them to xAI for the Colossus 2 Memphis data center.
Google owns Wiz following the $32B all-cash acquisition completed on March 11, 2026; Wiz operates within Google Cloud retaining its brand.
OpenAI owns io Products after the ~$6.5B all-stock acquisition; the io team officially merged with OpenAI on July 9, 2025 while LoveFrom remains an independent design partner.
SoftBank owns Ampere Computing as an indirect wholly owned subsidiary after the $6.5B all-cash acquisition completed November 25, 2025 (U.S. time).
Google holds a non-exclusive ~$2.7B license to Character.AI’s LLM technology with co-founders Noam Shazeer and Daniel de Freitas returning to Google DeepMind; no equity changed hands.

NVIDIA’s ~$20B non-exclusive license of Groq’s LPU inference technology (announced December 24, 2025) with founder/CEO Jonathan Ross and senior leaders joining NVIDIA; Groq remains independent under CEO Simon Edwards.

Stripe agreed to acquire OpenRouter (announced August 19, 2026, terms undisclosed); recorded as strategic_partner rather than equity_shareholder because no completion was confirmed as of the last review.

NVIDIA owns Run:ai following the acquisition completed December 30, 2024, after the European Commission’s unconditional Phase 1 clearance (case M.11766) on December 20, 2024; Run:ai’s GPU orchestration software remains available and was slated to be open-sourced.

NVIDIA reportedly owns Gretel after acquiring the synthetic-data startup in a nine-figure deal that had closed by the March 19, 2025 report (per WIRED, two people with direct knowledge); Gretel’s ~80 employees were folded into NVIDIA.

NVIDIA reportedly owns Lepton AI after closing its acquisition of the GPU cloud reseller (The Information, April 9, 2025); co-founders Yangqing Jia and Junjie Bai joined NVIDIA, with Jia as VP, System Software.

NVIDIA licensed Enfabrica’s networking-silicon technology in a reported >$900M cash-and-stock package (closed the week before the September 18, 2025 CNBC report) and hired CEO Rochan Sankar plus other employees; Enfabrica was not reported acquired.

NVIDIA has been a minority equity investor in Enfabrica since participating in the startup’s $125M Series B in 2023 (exact stake and dates undisclosed); the September 2025 >$900M license-plus-hire package was separate and paid in cash and NVIDIA stock.

AMD owns Silo AI following the ~$665M all-cash acquisition completed August 9, 2024 (per AMD’s 10-Q); the lab operates within AMD’s Artificial Intelligence Group under CEO Peter Sarlin reporting to Vamsi Boppana.
MGX participating investor in xAI $20B Series E alongside Valor Equity Partners, StepStone, Fidelity, QIA and Baron.
MGX co-lead equity investor in Anthropic $30B Series G at a $380B post-money valuation.
MGX co-led OpenAI's record $122B funding round closed March 31, 2026 at an $852B post-money valuation.
Andreessen Horowitz co-led Anduril $5B Series H at a $61B valuation alongside Thrive Capital.
NVIDIA invested $30 billion in OpenAI's $122B round at an $852B post-money valuation, alongside the expanded compute collaboration (3 GW dedicated inference and 2 GW Vera Rubin training).

Amazon committed $50 billion in OpenAI's $122B round ($15B initial, $35B contingent on an IPO or AGI), alongside a strategic partnership making AWS the exclusive third-party cloud distributor for OpenAI Frontier and expanding the $38B AWS deal by $100B.

CoreWeave owns Weights & Biases following its acquisition, completed May 5, 2025 (agreed March 4, 2025; press-reported ~$1.7B, terms officially undisclosed); W&B tooling is positioned as the developer-platform entry point into the CoreWeave Cloud.

Meta completed its acquisition of PlayAI (reported July 11, 2025); the entire PlayAI team joined Meta Superintelligence Labs reporting to Johan Schalkwyk. Terms undisclosed; ownership inferred from Bloomberg's "completed a deal to acquire" reporting, so evidence is reported_secondary.

Microsoft's ~$650M license-plus-hire arrangement with Inflection AI (March 2024): Microsoft licenses Inflection's models (~$620M reported non-exclusive license) after hiring co-founders Mustafa Suleyman and Karen Simonyan plus most of the ~70-person team; recorded as strategic_partner rather than equity_shareholder because Microsoft took no Inflection equity and the company continued operating independently.

Core Scientific hosts CoreWeave's NVIDIA GPU/HPC operations under a series of long-duration colocation contracts beginning with ~200 MW announced June 2024 and expanded to ~840 gross MW supporting CoreWeave HPC contracts by July 2025 (funded by CoreWeave capex with revenue credits); the commercial relationship survived the terminated merger on October 30, 2025, with both companies publicly committing to continue the partnership.

NVIDIA signed a definitive agreement on September 2, 2026 to acquire Hugging Face for ~$12.93B (~$11.9B to stockholders plus up to ~$1.0B employee retention); closing is expected in the first half of 2027 pending regulatory approvals, so NVIDIA is a prospective - not yet current - equity holder. Typed as 'other' rather than 'equity_shareholder' until the acquisition completes.

Space Exploration Technologies Corp. (SpaceX) completed its all-stock acquisition of X.AI Holdings Corp. (xAI) on February 2, 2026 via a two-step Nevada merger (K2 Merger Subs), making xAI - the Grok developer that owns the X social platform - a wholly owned SpaceX subsidiary (SpaceX is also the managing member of X.AI Holdings per Nevada filings reported by CNBC).
